note: Recast from the revision by Constantino (1995), the original in English. Both the soldier and the large worker are described; soldier measurements: 3 soldiers from 3 colonies, head length 4.35—4.80 mm, maximum head width 4.20—4.45 mm, head height without the postmentum 2.45—2.65 mm, frontal tube length 0.15—0.17 mm, left mandible length 2.50—2.60 mm, left mandible curvature 0.65—0.70 mm, mandible M1—M2 distance 0.54—0.55 mm, left mandible width 0.67 mm, left mandible M1 length 0.13—0.15 mm, minimum postmentum width 0.76—0.81 mm, pronotum width 2.95—3.10 mm, metanotum width 2.95—3.05 mm, hind tibia length 4.45 mm. Broken numbers of the kind shown as "4.3.5-4.80" in the OCR have been corrected from context.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Characterised by the relatively small body size, the very short frontal tube, both mandibular marginal teeth weak, and the moderately developed thoracic spines; the most similar soldier is S. peruanus, which is larger and has a larger left mandibular marginal tooth.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head length and width subequal, the sides nearly parallel and slightly convex, the posterior margin nearly round. Frontal tube very short, the opening clearly visible in dorsal view. Labrum short, length and width subequal, the lateral corners about right-angled, the midlobe short. Antenna 19 segments. Postmentum not constricted, the posterior sides nearly parallel. Mandibles curved, moderately elongate, the tip slightly hooked; the first marginal tooth of the left mandible situated at the middle, small, projecting only slightly beyond the apical cutting edge; the first marginal tooth of the right mandible small but distinct, the angle between its anterior edge and the apical cutting edge obtuse; the apical cutting edge of the left mandible distinctly S-shaped, forming a notch before M1; the apical cutting edge of the right mandible evenly curved. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: fontanelle round, medium-sized, convex; antenna 20 segments; mandibles similar to those of S. wheeleri, the molar region wide. The hindgut was not dissected, the available material being poorly preserved.
